crosswalks.historical_boundary: Continental France within the modern-border demographic envelope used by Goldstone and the 528,400 km2 departmental envelope reconstructed by Lot
crosswalks.resolution_method: Reuse the accepted france_region selector and calibrated geometry from the superseded interval crosswalk. The mapped footprint covers 96.21% of Lot's stated continental envelope, clearing the 95% aggregate-boundary gate; the remaining 3.79% is retained as explicit unmapped area and is not silently rescaled.
crosswalks.notes: The boundary is adequate for a one-sided aggregate test. Cities and ports remain inside the national aggregate, while the lower-bound semantics do not treat their populations as surrounding-land capacity labels.
